shortDescription: Configure OSPFv3 area settings on SONiC.

options.name: config
options.description: Specifies configuration for OSPFv3 areas. I(stub) and I(nssa) are mutually exclusive. If I(area_id=0 or 0.0.0.0), I(stub/nssa) should not be specified.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the type of configuration update to be performed on the device.
